rows.name: Candid UGC
rows.what: A photograph a real person would have taken of themselves or a friend. The register most swipes are in.

extra.shot: close, at the subject's own height, level, straight on, shallow depth so the background falls away
extra.light: soft frontal light with a slight top-down bias, raking enough to show surface texture rather than flatter it
extra.grade: natural grade, true colour, blacks lifted slightly
extra.style: candid, unstyled, native to a phone camera roll
extra.texture: unretouched and no better than the source — visible pores, follicles, marks and micro-shadows, slight softness, the compression and noise of a phone photo, nothing smoothed and nothing upgraded

rows.name: Mirror selfie
rows.what: Shot through a mirror, phone visible in the subject's hands. The only register where a phone belongs in frame, because the mirror explains it.

extra.shot: medium close, chest height, level, seen through a wall-mounted mirror, moderate depth with the subject sharp
extra.light: hard natural daylight from one side with deep shadow opposite, mixed with ambient room fill
extra.grade: natural grade, crushed blacks in the deep shadows
extra.style: native phone mirror selfie, unstyled domestic interior
extra.texture: unretouched — real skin with visible pores and natural imperfections

rows.name: Studio object
rows.what: The product alone on a controlled ground. Everything that reads as the ad is composited afterwards.

extra.shot: straight on, level, at the height of the object, centre-weighted, deep focus edge to edge
extra.light: soft overhead fill building a smooth gradient, one hard rim light entering from the side
extra.style: clean digital studio render, no film grain, no texture on the ground beyond its own sheen
extra.texture: true material finish — matte where matte, reflective where reflective

rows.name: Flat vector
rows.what: Drawn, not photographed. Meme and comic register — the swipe file uses it to make a problem safe to look at.

extra.shot: straight on, level, chest height, subject centred and cut at the upper thigh, everything equally crisp
extra.light: flat, soft and uniform, no modelling
extra.grade: solid colour fills on a flat ground
extra.style: flat vector illustration, thick black outlines, solid fills, no gradients, meme and comic aesthetic
extra.texture: none — clean digital, no shading, no realistic rendering

rows.name: Diagnostic scan
rows.what: A glowing translucent body against a void. Reframes a cosmetic problem as a medical reading.

extra.shot: profile or three-quarter, at eye height, level, cropped at the chest, deep focus
extra.light: strong warm rim light from behind and to one side, soft fill from the front
extra.grade: high contrast, crushed blacks, gradient void from charcoal at centre to near-black at the edges
extra.style: clean digital 3D medical infographic, glowing and semi-translucent
extra.texture: pathology reads as denser, more opaque interruptions in the glow

rows.name: Selfie
rows.what: She is holding the camera. The phone IS the camera, so it is never in frame — a phone visible in a selfie means the picture is OF someone taking a selfie, which is a different photograph (the owner, 2026-09-14).

extra.shot: arm's length, at her own eye height or slightly above, one arm out of frame toward the lens, close, deep enough focus that the room behind reads
extra.light: whatever light the room has — a window, a lamp, mixed and uncorrected
extra.style: a photograph she took of herself on her own phone and posted the same day
extra.texture: unretouched and no better than the source — pores, flyaways, uneven skin, phone-camera softness and noise, nothing smoothed, nothing upgraded

rows.name: Studio portrait, black and white
rows.what: A deliberate editorial portrait against a void. The one register here that is allowed to look made.

extra.shot: close, eye height, level, portrait-compressed, moderate depth
extra.light: soft directional loop light from one side, falling off into black
extra.grade: black and white, crushed blacks, high contrast on the eyes
extra.style: editorial portrait against a dark flat void, no environment
extra.texture: every pore, line and hair kept — the point of the register is age, undisguised

rows.name: Scanned vintage print
rows.what: Reads as a physical photograph that was kept, held and scanned — not a filter.

extra.shot: mid-shot, chest height, level, moderate depth
extra.light: frontal, soft, like a bounced on-camera flash
extra.grade: warm sepia or monochrome, lifted blacks
extra.style: a scanned physical film print — heavy grain throughout, creases across the image, yellowed borders, surface glare in one corner
extra.texture: the damage is real: grain, folds, the gloss of a print under light
